home.title: Introduction
home.description: RT Design System is a comprehensive design system for building consistent, accessible, and beautiful user interfaces.
home.overview: This design system provides a set of reusable components, design tokens, and guidelines to help you build cohesive user experiences.

principles.title: Consistent
principles.description: A unified design language across all products and platforms.

principles.title: Accessible
principles.description: Built with accessibility as a first-class concern.

principles.title: Composable
principles.description: Small, focused components that combine to build complex UIs.

principles.title: Themeable
principles.description: Supports light and dark themes with customizable tokens.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Get started with RT Design System in your project.
installation.setupGuide: Import the CSS and wrap your app with the theme provider.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: The color system is composed of primary colors, extended palettes, and semantic alert colors for the Radiotherapy Cloud platform.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Typography tokens and guidelines for consistent text rendering in the Radiotherapy Cloud platform.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icon guidelines and usage patterns for the design system.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: A consistent spacing scale for margins, padding, and gaps.

components-button.title: Button
components-button.description: Trigger an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

components-avatar.title: Avatar
components-avatar.description: Display user profile images or initials in a consistent format.

components-badge.title: Badge
components-badge.description: Highlight status or categorize items with small labels.

components-checkbox.title: Checkbox
components-checkbox.description: Allow users to select one or more items from a set.

components-input.title: Input
components-input.description: Single-line text input field for forms.

components-modal.title: Modal
components-modal.description: A dialog overlay that requires user interaction.

components-select.title: Select
components-select.description: A dropdown selector for choosing from a list of options.

components-switch.title: Switch
components-switch.description: Toggle between two states like on and off.

components-toast.title: Toast
components-toast.description: Brief notification messages that appear temporarily.
